title: Prove one-query endpoint and paid-scan bounds for the triangular carrier
body:
For the fixed triangular carrier C_f=[[Q_f−I,N_f],[Q_f,0]], one unary query cannot implement an all-size factorization over a fixed finite uniform-tensor physical-monomial endpoint dictionary. An independent proof allows nonuniform growing controllers and forces endpoint supports K_G·K_F≥4^f, hence at least 2f scalar bank ADDs. A paid O(f) ADD word is permitted.

The actual-base checker computes all 19 native 64×64 Gaussian matrices (N and 18 primal/dual Q cases), every independent column and orthonormality, with maximum amplitude 1/2. A monomial mislabelled as native rejects. The restored-helper extension retains its essential queried-width ≤ M premise and tests the point where the dimension argument stops.

The named repeated, varied-primal and primal/dual-route five-query scripts and exact receipts are retained as an archival appendix. These large searches are not reexecuted by the registered command and do not imply a general five-query impossibility. Changed cuts, multi-bank queries, wider queried helpers, nonmonomial endpoints and cross-cut sharing remain outside the theorem. No complete-caller stock floor, new κ or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Only `research/one-query-endpoint-scan/` is added. Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/one-query-endpoint-scan
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/one-query-endpoint-scan --check-source-history
```

At exact head `bf793d8739ad26f2aaba023de6bebca50fc67356-standalone`, registered normal/optimized replay, committed raw-byte/source-history checks and official export/integrity pass. The read-only Git-free export also passes normal/optimized isolated Python with empty PATH and unchanged source bytes/modes/inodes. Export SHA256: `c0f2804349f0c012232e55262ed5016318c5fadfcda9ea19d23308485261d22a`. Hosted CI is reported separately. A separate Codex review checked the proofs and unchanged mathematical bytes plus the final attribution/license delta; no independent human or kernel acceptance is claimed.
